implementation_statement: The BSS and the productivity suite lock accounts after repeated failed sign-ins using vendor defaults (confirmed in settings). The customer portal locks after 5 failures.

The MSP enforces a 10-minute screen lock on laptops. Gap: the front counter desktop is excluded so it can display the outage map, and the 3 technician tablets use a 4-digit passcode with no automatic lock policy.

The Network Operations Lead and the network engineering consultant reach the hut over a VPN on the edge router. Staff reach SaaS systems over the internet. Gaps: the consultant uses a shared VPN login with no MFA; the VPN runs on router firmware 2 years behind; the EMS web page was also reachable from the internet until 2026-08-03.
Office staff Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a shared password managed by the MSP; guest Wi-Fi in the lobby is separated and has internet access only. There is no Wi-Fi in the network hut.

The MSP emails a monthly security tip. Gap: no security awareness training, no phishing exercises, and no training on reporting incidents. Planned: annual training and quarterly phishing simulations from 2026-10.

Gap: Customer Service Representatives learn CPNI rules on the job only; no written material, no record, no refresher. Planned: a 1-hour CPNI and customer authentication course at hire and every year for representatives, the Office Manager, and Field Technicians, with a signed record, by 2026-10-31.

implementation_statement: Gap: nobody reviews logs. Planned from 2026-10: a monthly 30-minute review of BSS account-view reports (call detail views without a matching call or ticket), voice platform CDR exports and sign-ins, and VPN logins, recorded on a checklist.

An independent consultant assessed 13 controls on 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 (P07). POL-02 requires an annual assessment.

The EMS saves OLT configurations nightly and the router configuration is copied after each change. Gap: there is no documented standard configuration for OLTs, the aggregation switch, or ONT profiles to compare against.
evidence: EMS backup list; router configuration file

implementation_statement: Management protocols are set by the network engineering consultant at install. Gaps: OLT command-line access uses Telnet; SNMP uses version 2c with community strings unchanged since 2018 (P07 found the vendor default read-write string still active on the aggregation switch).

The EMS lists the OLTs and every ONT with serial number and customer port; the MSP lists office computers. Gap: no single inventory of routers, servers, tablets, SaaS services, or where CPNI and customer PII are stored. Planned: one-page inventory by 2026-10-31.
evidence: EMS inventory export; MSP device list

implementation_statement: Gap: no contingency plan. Hurricane preparation is a verbal routine (fuel the generator, stage spares). Planned: a short plan built from the BIA (P05) with a hut-loss procedure, a hurricane checklist, DIRS reporting steps, and customer 911 messaging, by 2026-11-30.

Gap: no configuration restore has ever been tested and the plan has never been exercised. Planned: restore an OLT and router configuration to the spare chassis in the warehouse by 2026-10-31, then twice a year; annual tabletop with the P08 runbook.

Gap: one leased 10 Gbps middle-mile circuit carries all traffic, with no diverse path. Planned: quotes for a second, physically diverse circuit by 2026-12-31; the board decision is a 2027 budget item.
